svg.title: BILL DECODER — AI Utility-Bill Extraction & Q&A
svg.desc: Reads K-Electric, LESCO and IESCO electricity-bill images into a strict JSON schema, then answers plain-English questions about the bill with calculations grounded in the extracted data, not guessed.
